brief.title: Simulate K candidate multi-step action sequences in representation space and rank feasible plans
brief.plain_summary: Encode initial environment observations into factored world states, predict multi-step transitions for K candidate sequences and rank invariant-preserving plans by goal distance plus cumulative risk energy.
brief.outcome: Ranked counterfactual rollout table and minimum-energy feasible sequence recommendation.

rollout_bundle.description: Pin of initial observation, target goal state and K candidate action sequences.

output_contract.delivery: Write produced nouns surface_only under your own authenticated surface, which is the requester's assigned surface, so the requester and that surface's reviewers can read them. Never use public_commons or allowlist other surfaces. Return every produced noun's pin in output.artifacts; add its value when the requester asks for inline delivery.

acceptance_checks.check: Trajectories that violate lease fencing, capability taint isolation, CAS monotonicity or non-negative quotas are marked infeasible and never recommended.

required: Encode raw environment observations into FactoredWorldState embeddings discarding surface timestamp and formatting noise.
